@s1 stated
  relation "be"
  role subject "the user's patient"
  role object "67 years old"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user's patient"
  role object "hypertension grade 2"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user's patient"
  role object "type 2 diabetes"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "take"
  role subject "the user's patient"
  role object "metformin 1000 mg twice daily"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user's patient"
  role object "glomerular filtration rate 38 ml/min/1,73m²"
  role time "at the last test"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  mode explain
  where match
    relation "reduce the dose of metformin"
    role subject "the user"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  mode explain
  where match
    relation "switch directly to another oral antidiabetic"
    role subject "the user"
    polarity affirmed
  end
